content: Heeƴ ciŋ Yuusufa
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yaŋhooɓa, a nikee ŋ Kanaan ŋ kur ka baab ɓa genohaahe.

Inii weɗ naandsuku ŋ Yaŋhooɓa na kahan ce. Wa kuɓkiŋ ɗe Yuusufa raak kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis yasna-kanak (17), a meeɗee hun na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe, ɓa niiɗee mbaal ca na pe' caŋ baab ɓa. A nikee komaaki, a meeɗta hun na kuɓuuciŋ Bilha na ɓiŋ Silpa, ɓitiɓ ciŋ baab ɓa. Taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe tummba in moɗaaɗi ɗah, a woo baab ɓa wa.
Israayel raakee ɗe ŋ kiyaɓkookaŋ ɗe, tahha po a yi a uupee waaɗ ŋ kuɓuuciŋ ɗe jen. A haɓɗiɗta ɗe kulɓa moɗoh na moɗoh.
Taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe hotta ne baab ɓa uupee ɗe waaɗ, weɗi tahee ɓa sang ɗe po, ɓa mineeɗi woo na ɗe sah, woo moɗoɗ.
Wa kaɗeeɗa po, Yuusufa heeƴca, a naandsukka taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe wa, ɓa uuppa ɗe nga sang.
A woo ɓa ne : « Sikɗukaat ini ŋ heeƴ.
An ɓoo nikee ŋ yohon ca, ɓoo tokeeɗa bele, ɗekka po ɗufiŋ ngo tufukka, ciŋ ɗu willaa, ca ƴekɗeeɗaa. »
Taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe woosa ɗe ne : « Fu waaɗ woo ne a fu na hee nike buuriŋ ɓoo e ? Fu yilif ɓoo e ? » Tahha po ɓa uuppa ɗe sang, sagu heeƴ caŋ ɗe na in ca a woyee nga.
Wa Yuusufa heeƴis, a naandsukissaa taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe an : « Hee ! Ŋ heeƴissiɗ nohi na caɓni na hor ndaŋkiyaah na yino ƴekɗeeɗa so. »
A nammbaa naandsuk baab ɓa, yeem ngassa ɗe an : « Fu heeƴ ye weem ? Fu liiɓiɗ ne mi na yaay ɗu na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa, ɓoo hey ɗa ƴekɗe e ? »
Taambɗoh ciŋ Yuusufa ayrukka ɗe, Yaŋhooɓa ɗaakohha heeƴ ceem nof.
Taambɗoh ciŋ Yuusufa tooniɗ ɗe
Wa raakeen jamano, taambɗoh ciŋ Yuusufa kaɗta mangaana na gataŋ baab ɓa ŋ ɓak kur ka na woyse Sisem.

Mbeh, Israayel woosa kuɓkiŋ ɗe Yuusufa ne : « Haya ŋ woos ɗa, fu marka taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa ŋ Sisem, ndah ɓa ɗaa ŋ jam na ɗoopaat ca. In nu raak nga ɗah, fu woo so. » Yuusufa woosa ɗe ne : « Ee. » A tuuƴca Yuusufa, yeem pulohha Oonaŋ-Hebron, a rappa ŋ ɓak Sisem.
Ƴaar cohha na ɗe wiltiɗoheeɗa ŋ bilaf fa, a meekissa ɗe ne : « Fu na waake ye ? »
Yuusufa woosa ɗe ne : « Mi na marke taambɗoh ciŋ ngo, fu miniɗ to woo ɗiski ɓa na niiɗohe e ? »
Ƴaara loffa ɗe ne : « Ɓa kurkiɗ ndii, ŋ kerhiɗ ɓa woyeeɗa ne ɓaa kee Dotan. » Yuusufa kaɗta ɓa raaka ŋ Dotan.
Wa taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ƴok ɗe hayeeɗa, bala a reyan nga ɓa ɗah, ɓa waakohha ɗe ap.
Ɓa woytiɗohha ŋ harmban ɓa ne : « Heɗ heeƴ ci a yoon na haye.
Ɓoo apaat ɗe, ɓoo ɓek ɗe ŋ ngurtut. Hey ɗah, ɓoo woo ne a ɗoopaat saahiɗ ap ɗe ; ɓoo marak findi heeƴ ciŋ ɗe na hee mirndohe. »
Wa Ruben kerah ineem, a waaɗta muciɗ Yuusufa, a woosa ɓa ne : « Ɓoo kanaat ɗe ap. »
A degga nga ne : « Kanaat aam ñif, ɓekaat ɗe ŋ ngurtuta ŋ bilaf fa ween, yaah ciŋ ɓoo degkuu ɗe. » A woosa ɓa ineem ne a min ɗe muciɗ po a wik ɗe baab ɓa.
Wa Yuusufa ree, ɓa ammba ɗe, ɓa wolissa kulɓaakaŋ ɗe moɗohngaana,
ɓa njaffa ɗe ŋ ɗooƴ ngurtuta.
Ƴutta ɓa ɓooffa ne ɓa ñam. Ɗekka po ɓa hotta Ismaayla-Ismaaylaaca huniɗ, pulohiɗ Galaad na ngeelemb caŋ ɓa sifiɗ ɓi toon findi cuuraay, daakaande na diw faan, ɓa kaɗeeɗa Misra.
Yudaa woosa taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ne : « Wa raakiɗ ɓoo winde etoh, ɓoo ap taambɗoh ɓoo po ƴut, ɓoo ɗasɗohee wa ?
Ismaayla-Ismaaylaaca ɓeɗɗeen na haye, ɓoo toonaat ɓa ɗe, ɓoo apuu ɗe laam, e ɓoo ɓaah ñif, a taambɗoh ɓoo. » Ɓa hunnda nga.
Wa toonoh ca ree, tel ɓa puloh kur ka na woyse Majaan, ɓa puliɗta Yuusufa ŋ ngurtuta, ɓa toonohha ɓa ɗe ƴel haalis ndaŋkiyaah-kanak (20) ; Ismaayla-Ismaaylaaca cootta na ɗe Misra.
Wa Ruben wiiruk ngurtuta, a hotta ne Yuusufa nikisɗi nga, keeñaŋ ɗe reehha, a faarra kulɓaacaŋ ɗe.
A kaɗta ŋ taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe, a woosa ɓa ne : « Cooy, Yuusufa nikisɗi ndaam ! Ŋ tuman na ? »
Ɓa hoossa suket, ɓa tahha'iɗta kulɓaakaŋ Yuusufa na ñif ma.
Ƴutta ɓa kommba baab ɓa wa, ɓa woosa ɗe ne : « Inii, ɓoo paraha parah, wa kulɓaakiŋ kuɓkiŋ ɗa haa e ? »
Yaŋhooɓa inhissaa, a woosa ne : « Marka ! A ɗoopaat saahiɗ sifiñsoh ɗe, cooy, Yuusufa sifiñsohuuɗ ! »
Wa Yaŋhooɓa inhis kulɓaaka, weɗi a faaroh kulɓaacaŋ ɗe, a ɓekukka daah, a ruyiɗta kuɓkiŋ ɗe neeh laayiɗ.
Kuɓuuciŋ ɗe jen, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ giifɗeeɗa ɗe, waaye a sannga, a woosa ne : « Ŋ nikan ŋ ruy po mbaɗna maa hee ɗe raake ŋ Jaanim. » A taalndiɗta, a fuɗeeɗa kuɓkiŋ ɗe.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Majaan-Majaan ca ɓayee Yuusufa Misra, ɓa toon ɗe Potifaar, ƴaara adgohee dag caŋ Firawnaana.
